summary: Fix payload replacement and preservation during copy-on-write cloning.
explanation: In Status.TestGetSetPayload, the test sets kUrl1 first to kPayload1 ("aaaaa"), then to kPayload3 ("ccccc"); GetPayload(kUrl1) is expected to return "ccccc" but returns "aaaaa" because SetPayload exits when the URL already exists. In Status.CopyOnWriteForErasePayload, the test copies a status containing the sole kUrl1 payload and expects copy.ErasePayload(kUrl1), then base.ErasePayload(kUrl1), to return true. CloneAndUnref clones payloads only when there are more than one, so both copy-on-write paths discard the sole payload and erase returns false. Updating existing entries and cloning any nonempty payload collection restores both contracts while leaving the empty-payload case unchanged.
